caption:
Your pipeline has money sitting in it right now.

Every service business has leads that got one reply, then went quiet.

Run this every Friday:

1. Filter leads from the past 7 days with no logged reply.
2. Text each one this exact line: "Hey [name], I dropped the ball following up fast. Still need [service]?"
3. Call anyone who replies within the hour.

Most shops never circle back, so a direct, honest text stands out.

Any CRM with a last-contacted filter runs this in minutes. Black Arrow OS does it for free.
